messages.author: 20c6dbb46920d12c
messages.subject: geom_histogram not working
parts:
Hi all,

I'm guessing nobody else is currently having this issue, but has anyone heard of it or know what's causing it? I've never experienced this before, but suddenly, the following code fails to plot any data. geom_density works, but not geom_histogram. And I'm getting the message about the default binning, etc., so I know it's calling the right thing. It's just not plotting anything.

Thanks for the help. One of those strange moments when something seems to suddenly stop working.

tst <- data.frame(x = rnorm(1000))
ggplot(tst,aes(x)) + geom_histogram()
